prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: individual premium cafe product catalogue photo, portrait 3:4.
Primary request: Create a polished, appetising PHOTOREALISTIC product photo based on the attached exact product. Input image is the product edit target and identity reference.
Preserve the exact short wide clear plastic sundae cup shape and proportions, clear hemispherical dome lid, shallow deep-red strawberry layer along the bottom, pale milk and marbled green matcha above, and light foam plus existing modest matcha dusting under the lid. Preserve the front mascot sticker precisely: smiling brown-haired girl, small white bunny with exactly TWO ears, and legible 128am Cafe branding. Do not redesign packaging or invent toppings. Keep entire cup and dome in frame, facing viewer.
Improve exposure and natural appetising colour with realistic green matcha, deep red fruit, clean whites, controlled highlights, and delicate cold condensation on plastic.
Photographic medium: luxury food photography with tactile realistic materials, soft dimensional shadow, accurate optics, believable product scale, not illustration or CGI.
Brand palette: cream #FFF8F5, rose #B8496C, pink #FDE5EB, sage #E7F0DC.
Typography: large bold rounded playful Fredoka-style lowercase heading, clean and consistent; exact text "strawberry matcha latte", arranged in TWO centered lines at top: "strawberry" then "matcha latte". Smaller exact text "128am Cafe" centered directly below heading. Text in warm cocoa #634C43 or brand rose, high legibility, generous safe margins. Reserve the top quarter for typography, product dominant below. Render words accurately.
No prices, no promotional claims, no watermark, no border, no collage, no extra text. One finished image only.
Scene/backdrop: Ivory linen still life. Cup on tactile ivory linen, a subtle pale-pink cloth with soft folds lying off to one side. Warm cream seamless backdrop, diffuse light, natural shadows. Cloth never covers or touches the logo.
